questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Jargon
questions.solution:
A)Jargon(noun) – Special words or expressions used by a profession or group that are difficult for others to understand. शब्द जाल
Synonym:Slang(noun) – A type of language consisting of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, more common in speech than writing. बोल-चाल की भाषा
